workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Tue 13:00-13:30: Both busy (Elena: Quarterly planning, David: Client call)
- Tue 13:30-14:00: Both busy (Elena: Contract review, David: Busy)
- Wed 15:00-15:30: David busy (Partner lunch)
- Wed 15:30-16:00: Both busy (Elena: Budget review, David: Busy)
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel)
- Fri 11:00-11:30: Both busy (Elena: Client dinner prep, David: Training session)
- Fri 11:30-12:00: Both busy (Elena: 1:1, David: Litigation strategy)

Every slot where Priya and Marcus are both free has a conflict for either Elena or David (or both). This means there is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are available. We need to report this as infeasible.
